text: distributed catalogue contains: 40,482 normalized name records. 42,599 name--register relationships. 42,265 distinct country-register-identifier entries. 18,279 normalized-name candidate pairs. first three quantities represent different indexing units. text: Important considerations include: Registers may use different inclusion criteria. Reporting obligations update schedules can vary. Register counts direct measures lobbying activity. Absence register establish absence lobbying. Search candidates require independent interpretation.

title: Search Lobbying Organization Names — eulob_search
text: query Non-empty character string search . country Optional territorial code, `"ES"` `"UE"`. Converted uppercase filtering. limit Positive whole number specifying maximum number returned rows. Default `100L`. data_dir Must `NULL`. External catalogue directories supported version. method Matching algorithm. One `"cosine"` (default), `"jaccard"`, `"jw"`, `"dl"` `"fixed"`. min_similarity Optional minimum similarity 0 1. Default `NULL`, meaning threshold. Used approximate matching. q Positive integer specifying character q-gram length cosine Jaccard similarity. Default `2L`. p Jaro-Winkler prefix scaling factor 0 0.25. Default `0.1`. Used `method = "jw"`.

text: data frame containing: name_id Identifier associated normalized name. name Recorded organization name. country Territorial register code. register Name source register. lobby_id Register-specific entry identifier. similarity Numeric similarity score 0 1,       included approximate matching methods. Results limited requested number rows.   rows satisfy search criteria, empty data frame   corresponding columns returned.

title: Search Lobbying Organization Names — eulob_search
text: default method cosine similarity using character bigrams (`method = "cosine", q = 2L`). Approximate matching implemented using `stringdist` package. available methods : - `"cosine"`: cosine similarity character q-grams. - `"jaccard"`: Jaccard similarity character q-grams. - `"jw"`: Jaro-Winkler similarity. - `"dl"`: Damerau-Levenshtein similarity. - `"fixed"`: case-insensitive literal substring matching. Approximate methods return similarity score 0 1, higher values indicate greater string similarity. `min_similarity = NULL`, minimum similarity threshold applied. Consequently, approximate methods may return low-scoring unrelated results close match exists. positive threshold can specified restrict results. `"fixed"` method preserves original substring-search behavior. calculate similarity scores ignores approximate-matching parameters. Results represent name--register-identifier relationships, necessarily unique legal entities. organization name may appear several registers. Approximate results ordered decreasing similarity, followed normalized name, territorial code register identifier. Fixed results ordered normalized name, territorial code register identifier. Similarity lexical rather semantic. High similarity establish two names refer legal entity.
